name: Docker
description: Your Docker containers in a card Orkestri draws itself: grouped by compose project, with state, health, ports, uptime, CPU and memory; start, stop, restart, remove and logs, a whole project at once; images (clean up dangling ones) and disk use. Linked terminals list, start, stop, read logs and run commands. Uses the docker command of the computer (Docker Desktop or any engine docker reaches); downloads nothing, serves nothing. Not made or endorsed by Docker, Inc.
